best_for: PC players who own Ubisoft games, and want cloud saves, offline play and store discounts in one launcher.
description:
Ubisoft Connect is Ubisoft's free gaming service and the desktop launcher for its games on PC. The same service also runs inside Ubisoft games on consoles, so your friends list and rewards follow you from one device to another. It is closed source.

On PC, the launcher is where you open and manage your Ubisoft games. You can sort and customize your game library, bring over your friends from Steam, and chat with friends on other platforms. It suggests what to play next, and it is where you find free games, trials and betas, or sign up for Ubisoft+, the company's paid game subscription.

points.title: Free, with an account
points.text: The launcher costs nothing, but you sign in with a Ubisoft account.

points.title: Cloud saves are on by default
points.text: For games that support it, cloud save sync is on from the start, so you can carry progress to another platform. You can turn it off under Settings, General.

points.title: Offline play has conditions
points.text: You must launch a game online once before it will run offline, and not every game supports offline play. Offline, you lose cross-progression, online services and in-game stores.

points.title: Updates wait for a connection
points.text: Without internet the launcher starts in offline mode, and updates are not installed until you reconnect.

points.title: Units for store discounts
points.text: Playing earns Units, which you trade for in-game items or a 20 percent discount on the Ubisoft Store for 100 Units. The discount does not cover in-game purchases or subscriptions.

points.title: Windows only, current build only
points.text: There is no Mac or Linux version. The Windows installer is 32-bit and machine-wide, and the listing keeps only 1 version; the launcher updates itself.
